method: Manual visual screening at native/expanded size, using alpha-correct composites to inspect visible limbs. The two full-body corrections and one chibi correction were independently re-inspected after native image generation and atlas preparation. This is not a guarantee of perfect anatomy or every finger.

corrections.reason: Removed duplicated lowered forearm and lantern hand; separated the two legs for clear silhouette.
Removed extra central forearm and hand; retained two casting arms and an independently levitating staff.
Removed the third waist hand; one hand now holds the wand, the other carries the medical case.

zero_alpha_rgb_cleanup: RGB below exactly zero alpha cleared; the other 82 full-body visible pixels were verified unchanged against the previous Git commit.
